newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close over 1,100, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close over 1,100, seen mixed.

text.p: VIENNA, Nov 25 (Reuter) Austrian shares inched over the psychological 1,100 mark on Monday to close firmer, but traders were divided in their outlook for the week ahead.
"Crossing the 1,100 mark was hotly contested and I wouldn't say we're there yet," one trader said, noting the index could still fall back to 1,080.
"Today demand was low but I think we will stay above 1,100 this week," said another.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips climbed 3.17 points or 0.29 percent to 1,100.85. Among its constituents 13 ATX shares rose, seven fell and one was unchanged.
Semiconductor maker Austria Mikro Systeme (AMS) was the top gainer of the session, jumping 5.14 percent to 757 schillings, boosted by advances in U.S. electronics shares, traders said.
The company fell over 20 percent in October as investors anticipated a limp set of nine-month earnings.
AMS posted a pre-tax profit of just 58 million schillings as losses at its subsidiaries and a floundering global semiconductor market took their toll.
Luxury hosiery maker Wolford was the leading decliner, dropping 3.34 percent to 335.9 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index edged 1.01 points or 0.24 percent higher to 418.84.
The December ATX future added 6.7 points to 1,105.0.
